title: Suikinkutsu Garden
tagline: Tune a buried garden pot, drop water, and listen for a bright note match.

paper.title: A computational framework for the acoustic characterization of Suikinkutsu (water harp cave)

novelty: A note-matching water-drop toy combines synthesized pot resonance with an approachable tuning game; no known implementation (not verified).
description: An offline browser sound toy inspired by suikinkutsu, where drops falling into a hidden garden vessel create resonant sounds.
howItWorks: Adjust authored pot parameters to change a synthesized tone, then drop water to hear it and compare it with a target note. The paper's six descriptors motivate the listening context; this toy does not implement their analysis pipeline.
controls: Click or tap the target note to hear it. Adjust the labeled sliders, then click or tap the water or Drop a note button to play and check the match. Keyboard users can tab through controls, use arrow keys on sliders, and press Space on the water button.
